breakingChangesNotes: In the Cortex XDR Alerts Handling v2 playbook, the deprecated ***xdr-get-incident-extra-data*** command was replaced with ***xdr-case-list***, so the data is now written to **PaloAltoNetworksXDR.Case** instead of **PaloAltoNetworksXDR.Incident**. As a result, the default values of the *incident_id* and *alert_id* playbook inputs were updated to **PaloAltoNetworksXDR.Case.case_id** and **PaloAltoNetworksXDR.Case.Issues.issue_id** respectively. The input names are unchanged. Custom parent playbooks that run this playbook as a sub-playbook and pass these inputs explicitly must be updated to the new context paths. The Cortex XDR - Large Upload, Cortex XDR - Port Scan - Adjusted, Cortex XDR - Identity Analytics, Cortex XDR - First SSO Access - Set Verdict, and Cortex XDR Remote PsExec with LOLBIN command execution alert sub-playbooks were updated for the same reason: they now read **PaloAltoNetworksXDR.Case.Issues** instead of **PaloAltoNetworksXDR.Incident.alerts**, and the renamed case severity counters **PaloAltoNetworksXDR.Case.critical_severity_issue_count** and **PaloAltoNetworksXDR.Case.high_severity_issue_count** instead of **PaloAltoNetworksXDR.Incident.critical_severity_alert_count** and **PaloAltoNetworksXDR.Incident.high_severity_alert_count**. Custom playbooks or automations that populate **PaloAltoNetworksXDR.Incident** before running these playbooks must be updated to the new context paths.
